customers.title: Customers
customers.description: This segment captures all individuals with at least one paid transaction. Target everyone who has ever paid the studio (a class pass, a subscription, or even a coffee at the front desk).

active_members.title: Active Members
active_members.description: This segment groups all clients currently active. (have an active pass). Following the lifecycle status definition.

active_trials.title: Trials (intro offer)
active_trials.description: Convert new clients before their trial window closes. This segment groups all clients currently on an active trial or intro pass who have not yet made a second purchase.

information.label: About pre-built segments
information.title: Find key audiences instantly
information.description: Pre-built segments are automatically created groups based on common client behaviors.
information.update: They update over time using predefined rules, so clients enter or leave the segment as their activity changes. Pre-built segments help you target key audiences quickly without needing to create filters yourself.
information.custom: For custom criteria or advanced logic, use custom segments.
